method: 每项保持纸源或独立音证支持的正文词，仅映射到同一实际完整词声段；无猜秒、无词尾/词内比例插值、无全局不同词合并。

bindings.source_sentence_en: Now, we need to explain how and why this remarkable trait, you know, human’s ability to do things with language has evolved, and why did this trait evolve only in our species?
bindings.evidence: human’s与humans'在此同音/hjuːmənz/；纸源原样human’s。声学不能判定撇号归属，保留纸源字形，仅该同一真实整词时间共用。
bindings.evidence_ref: 核验/正文清理/2018-人工词锚证据.json

bindings.source_sentence_en: And so some time around 200,000 years ago, our species confronted this crisis.
bindings.evidence: 纸源some time，局部Whisper/主识别合写sometime；around 200,000 years ago语境同一时间表达。两词仅共享ASR真实sometime整词区间，不虚造内部time边界。
bindings.evidence_ref: 核验/正文清理/2018-人工词锚证据.json

bindings.source_sentence_en: But, as we spread out around the world, we developed thousands of different languages.
bindings.evidence: 数字/B1纸源过去式developed；独立Whisper399—414明确developed；Parakeet漏弱读词尾t为develop。采纳纸源与独立模型读法，保留过去式；仅该完整单词的真实声段绑定，无全局develop/developed等价。
bindings.evidence_ref: 核验/正文清理/2018-人工词锚证据.json
